title: PRISM SAFETY GPS (PRJ-PSG-01): Ultra-Compact ESP32-C3 BLE Edge-Gateway Safety Telemetry and Impact Detection System
description: Low-cost embedded personal safety device combining ESP32-C3, u-blox NEO-6M GPS, ADXL345 3-axis accelerometer impact-immobility detection, and a smartphone BLE 5.0 edge gateway with server-side dead-man's switch failover.
